optional_adapter_network_requirements.prometheus: Read-only outbound HTTP GET to a Prometheus server (opt-in).
optional_adapter_network_requirements.shadow: Read-only HPA/state reads via the Prometheus client (kube-state-metrics); no Kubernetes SDK, no mutation (opt-in).

public_api_notes.ScalingExecutor: Inert Protocol (interface only). No concrete executor is shipped or invoked; the facade/CLI cannot supply or call one.
public_api_notes.ExecutionReceipt: Typed result for an external executor; never produced by this distribution.
public_api_notes.canonical: Phase 1 Canonical Capacity Intelligence subpackage (additive, pure-stdlib): provider-neutral CanonicalCapacityState, explicit normalization/projection into the UNCHANGED ScalingObservation, and immutable CapacityDecisionEvidence with a deterministic sha256 content-identity digest. Adds no dependency, no actuation, no authority integration; the five-signal decision kernel is unchanged.
public_api_notes.recommend_with_evidence: Controlled service path: project a CanonicalCapacityState -> run the unchanged CloudScalingController -> (ScalingRecommendation, CapacityDecisionEvidence). Evidence is bound to the real recommendation and cannot be forged by a caller-supplied recommendation.
public_api_notes.forecasting: Phase 2 Predictive Capacity Intelligence subpackage (additive, pure-stdlib): deterministic, provider-neutral, SHADOW-only forecasting and replay evaluation built AROUND the Phase-1 canonical layer. CanonicalCapacityState history -> CanonicalCapacitySeries -> leakage-safe ForecastInputWindow -> deterministic baseline forecaster (persistence/linear-trend) -> CapacityForecast (point + empirical uncertainty OR typed abstention) -> CapacityForecastEvidence (sha256 identity) -> ForecastEvaluationRecord. Adds no dependency, no actuation, no authority integration; forecasts NEVER feed the controller decision kernel.
public_api_notes.forecast_with_evidence: Controlled service path: build a leakage-safe input window at a cutoff -> run a deterministic baseline forecaster -> point forecast + empirical rolling-origin uncertainty OR a typed abstention -> immutable CapacityForecastEvidence. A forecast is descriptive capacity intelligence only (advisory_only=True, shadow_only=True, actuation_performed=False), never a recommendation, risk evaluation, authority, or execution instruction.
public_api_notes.run_replay_evaluation: Deterministic shadow replay: for each cutoff, forecast from history <= cutoff and match against a STRICTLY-later actual observation; produces immutable ForecastEvaluationRecords and a deterministic aggregate (count, abstention rate, MAE, RMSE, bias, interval coverage/width, unmatched). Shadow only; never promotes a model or changes controller configuration.

canonical_capacity_intelligence.evidence_digest: sha256 over a documented, domain-separated canonical form; a content IDENTITY only (not a signature, risk verdict, authorization, control-satisfaction claim, or execution permission).
canonical_capacity_intelligence.risk_authority_integration: NONE (Phase 1 produces upstream recommendation evidence only; a future separately-governed integration package may reference the evidence digest/identity).

predictive_capacity_intelligence.supported_horizons: explicitly configured (e.g. 5m / 15m / 60m); no horizon-specific scaling behavior is hardcoded
predictive_capacity_intelligence.uncertainty_method: empirical_rolling_origin_residual (non-Gaussian; calibration-gated; explicit 'unavailable' when insufficient residuals)
predictive_capacity_intelligence.value_space: Forecast values are disclosed as projected_without_conversion (raw canonical target domain; default) or normalized (Phase-1 normalize_signal applied to a ratio in [0,1]); the applied space + normalization_policy_digest are bound into the input-window and evidence digests. No silent unit conversion; running_replicas -> current_replicas without substitution.
predictive_capacity_intelligence.domain_enforcement: SignalDomain (bounds + integer semantics) sourced from the Phase-1 unit_domain authority is enforced on BOTH input observations and output forecasts; fractional/out-of-domain values fail closed (never clamped/rounded); domain failures are evidence-producing abstentions.
predictive_capacity_intelligence.evaluation_construction: ForecastEvaluationRecord EMBEDS the canonical actual state for EVALUATED outcomes and derives actual_state_digest/value/unit/subject-binding from it; construction AND from_dict re-validate the binding (a forged value or digest, or a subject/target/unit mismatch, is rejected) plus recomputed errors/coverage. The evaluation digest is a content identity/integrity value, not a signature or authenticity proof.
predictive_capacity_intelligence.actual_matching: Deterministic and order-independent: filter by subject/tenant/scope, target, strictly-future event time, horizon, and tolerance; a unique closest candidate is scored, equidistant candidates yield a typed AMBIGUOUS (unscored) outcome (fail closed).
predictive_capacity_intelligence.abstention_admission: forecast_from_observations maps expected series-construction data-quality failures (invalid event-time order, conflicting/duplicate timestamps, cross-subject/tenant) to typed abstentions; other errors are not swallowed.
predictive_capacity_intelligence.leakage_prevention: Input windows contain only observations with event_time <= cutoff (invariant-checked); replay matches STRICTLY-later actuals; harness fails closed on any residual leakage.
predictive_capacity_intelligence.forecast_evidence_digest: sha256 over all authoritative fields (schema versions, subject/tenant, source-series + input-window digests, cutoff/forecast-for, target/horizon, model id/version + config digest, feature-config digest, normalization-policy digest, forecast-or-abstention output, uncertainty method/config); excludes production time + non-authoritative diagnostic annotation. A content IDENTITY only, not a signature/authorization/accuracy proof.
predictive_capacity_intelligence.predictive_quality: PREDICTIVE_QUALITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED (baseline implementation verified for correctness only; no evaluation on representative external workloads against preregistered acceptance thresholds).

operations_code_location: cloud_scaling_operations/ (monorepo-only; not packaged; may become a separate ugence-cloud-scaling-operations distribution in a future, separately-governed phase)

legacy_imports.note: Operational legacy imports resolve to cloud_scaling_operations and are MONOREPO-ONLY; they are NOT part of the distributed wheel and NOT a stable distributed API.

known_limitations: Advisory-only: produces recommendations; contains no code capable of applying them.
Not live-cluster validated by this package; not production-certified.
Decision-deterministic; identity_deviation is a diagnostic that varies before deterministic bootstrap (see output determinism block). It affects no scaling decision.
No cost-savings, customer-validation, or real-cluster-superiority claims are made.
Execution/approval/orchestration code is NOT included in this distribution; it lives in the monorepo-only cloud_scaling_operations namespace.

Phase-2 forecasting is SHADOW-only and never feeds the controller; forecasts are baselines (persistence/linear-trend) whose PREDICTIVE quality is NOT established on representative external workloads (PREDICTIVE_QUALITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED). Passing tests/CI prove implementation correctness, not forecast accuracy.
provenance_policy: The static manifest carries stable metadata only. The actual build revision is generated at build/verification time from GITHUB_SHA or `git rev-parse HEAD` into artifacts/build_provenance.json (evidence_class CI_GENERATED_BUILD_EVIDENCE). No self-referential commit SHA is stored here.
